verdict.rationale: The evidence covers agent-side flows: catalog search, carts, checkout completion with negotiated payment handlers, and order webhooks or get_order sent to the agent. UCP states that businesses remain Merchant of Record, and carts carry UTM and referral attribution fields. None of the evidence documents how agent-originated payments settle into merchant payouts, appear in merchant financial reports, or reconcile alongside other sales channels. Merchant-of-record status and attribution are adjacent features and do not earn credit for this story.
